svg.title: PianoGrid chord reference
svg.text: Exact pitch examples. Read left to right from the lowest note.
Dots mark the sounding keys. Octave numbers are not finger numbers.
Each example keeps the chord tones but may use a different register.
No staff notation or hand-specific finger numbers are included in this PDF.
Keyboard window: C4–C6. Page hand examples have separate source notes.
Formula / notation references: Open Music Theory; Puget Sound Music Theory.
Original diagrams generated from the supplied note data. Content checked 2026-09-11.
